body:
Release QA campaign on merged main: started at `8f867ad0a29b6c814e8ed89225246d6926a1ff5b`, refreshed to `425afe9eeedf6248eb6f0e8272101fb90cef4b97`, and confirmed the latter was still main at closeout. The intervening five-line launch-script change does not affect the tested engine/bindings/dependencies.

**Result: not a 0.2.0 sign-off. Two newly reproduced blockers are open.** This report also leaves the existing 0.2.0 feature/release milestone work intact.

## Blocking findings

- [ ] **P1 #251:** filtered ANN exits on visit count before using its configured beam-widening budget. Reproduces in both ID-list and predicate modes on macOS/Linux ARM64. A 2,000-vector case returns five hits at initial beam 10 / cap 40; starting directly at the permitted beam 40 returns ten. Root: `vanedb/src/approx/mod.rs:750`.
- [ ] **P2 #252:** installed-wheel verification mistakes a sibling directory sharing the checkout's name prefix for part of the source tree and rejects a correctly installed wheel. Root: `scripts/check_wheel_install.py:33`. This is a QA-tool failure, not an engine correctness failure.

Each issue includes exact reproduction, current-main SHA, platform, expected/actual behavior, source reference, and regression-test acceptance. Both are labeled `release-blocker` and assigned to milestone `0.2.0`.

## Tests actually executed in this campaign

| Coverage | Result |
|---|---|
| Rust workspace with disk, excluding Python — macOS ARM64 | 318 passed |
| Same — Linux ARM64 VM | 318 passed |
| Rust core with disk — macOS x86-64 binaries under Rosetta | 280 passed |
| Frozen C++ reference — macOS ARM64 | 98 CTest cases passed |
| Cross-engine harness / shared graph and disk formats | 39 passed |
| Locally built installed Python release wheel — macOS CPython 3.13.5 | 220 passed |
| Locally built installed Python release wheel — Linux CPython 3.12.14 | 220 passed |
| WASM under Node | 25 passed |
| Packaged npm ESM/CommonJS consumers and generated conversions | Passed |
| Packaged browser + IndexedDB persistence/page reload | Chrome, Firefox, WebKit passed |
| Local Metal component | 3 passed; no claim of index acceleration |
| Extracted C distribution | 2 CMake consumers and ctypes filter/persistence example passed |
| Expanded properties | 10,000 cases per each of 6 properties passed |
| Workflow/source/release checks | actionlint, rustfmt, workspace clippy, release/version/RFC scripts passed |

Upstream [CI on the tested engine revision](https://github.com/vanedb/vanedb/actions/runs/35539142211) has 51 successful jobs, including Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64/ARM64, Intel/ARM macOS, sanitizers, iOS ARM64 simulator, Android x86-64 emulator, and ARM64 mobile builds. [Final-main CI](https://github.com/vanedb/vanedb/actions/runs/35541066668) is green; its launch-script-only diff skips unaffected components. These are CI evidence, separate from local executions. No physical mobile-device testing was performed.

## Additional random, corruption, and load tests

- **120,000 mutation operations / 138,240 searches** over 240 seeded native Python cases: all metrics, dimensions 1/3/17/128, high u64 IDs, add/remove/upsert, growth, compaction, failed-batch atomicity, file/byte persistence, all filter modes, independent float64 exact oracle, mapped-disk parity. All passed on macOS/Linux.
- **22,500 WASM mutation operations / 2,376 searches**: all metrics × dimensions 3/17/128, high IDs, repeated save/free/load and compaction. All passed. Nine resulting graph files cross-loaded on macOS/Linux Python with every vector, graph bytes, and search output checked.
- **200,000 malformed-byte cases** across current and legacy formats: 174,776 rejected, 25,224 structurally accepted. Linux used a 768 MiB address-space cap; accepted inputs received bounded operational/round-trip checks. No engine crash/panic in the bounded runs. Valid bit mutations are expected without checksums (existing #249). An initial unbounded harness allocated an enormous Python query array from a valid empty index's dimension; that harness error was corrected and is not reported as an engine defect.
- **50,000×128 macOS and 20,000×384 Linux load workloads** passed. Each ran five reader threads totaling 3,750 queries alongside 3,000 upsert/remove iterations, 30 validated snapshots and three compactions, followed by verification of every original vector. Also checked byte/file round trips, mapped exact parity, and atomic file replacement preserving an already-open mapping. No deadlock or data loss observed.

## Real embedding recall

Pinned fixture SHA256 `4676911521f13dc6592d102cf3b4fcace85c6b62b3011e9bd57557dfc9c01f2d`; 100,000 BeIR/nq document embeddings × 768 dimensions, first 100 queries, cosine, M16, efConstruction200, seed42, k10, initial ef50. Reproduce with existing `scripts/filtered_search_recall.py /path/to/embeddings.vnef --queries 100 --caps 200 1600`.

| Selectivity | Cap 200 recall / full-result fraction | Cap 1600 recall / full-result fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 50% | .975 / 100% | .975 / 100% |
| 10% | .850 / 100% | .850 / 100% |
| 1% | .362 / 31% | .507 / 100% |

No filter membership violations. Recall values describe this dataset; #251 is the separate concrete failure to execute configured widening.

## Performance

Sequential **A-B-A-B** against published 0.1.1 (`vanedb-crate-v0.1.1`, commit `d1553dd65d56f1473c69a2e7fe43c5f39ceb4e12`), locally built with the same release toolchain. Five samples per operation per pass, 10k vectors at 128/768 dimensions, 64 deterministic queries.

Main/baseline deltas for build/search/flat-search/batch were +0.6%/+1.9%/+1.3%/+0.02% at 128d and +0.5%/-5.2%/+0.4%/+2.0% at 768d. Recall was identical across all four passes. Save/load differences did not establish a regression; the +3.7% 768d save delta was inside its 6.3% inter-pass spread. No new performance blocker was supported. These laptop timings are **diagnostic, not dedicated-hardware release evidence**, and do not satisfy or close #242.

## Follow-up

When fixes merge, refresh main, rebuild artifacts, re-run #251/#252 reproducers and affected suites, and update this report. Before releasing, finish the independently tracked 0.2.0 milestone acceptance work. No source fixes, PRs, or publication were performed by this QA campaign.
title: test(release): 0.2.0 QA campaign on main 425afe9 — results and two blockers
